proofAssessment.conclusion: Exact authored coefficient multiplication, no f64 conversion or rounding.
proofAssessment.proof: For coefficient C formed by concatenating whole/fraction ASCII digits, decimal scale 10^f and unit multiplier M in {1,1000,60000,3600000}, reversed-digit long multiplication computes C*M exactly. Incoming carry stays in [0,M-1]. Each step adds at most 9*M, so intermediate carry <=10*M-1<=35999999, far below u64 overflow. Modulo/divide-by-10 yields the exact reversed product digits. The lowest f product digits must all be zero for integral milliseconds; skipping those digits is therefore exact division by 10^f. Checked u64 decimal folding rejects integer overflow; final result requires 0<ms<=9007199254740991. Leading zeros and arbitrarily long trailing zeros introduce no precision ceiling; malformed ASCII spelling, signs and unsupported suffixes return None.
proofAssessment.resourceLimit: Storage/time are linear in literal length. 4096-digit cases were exercised; this review does not establish unbounded resource or fuzzing acceptance.
